title: Publication review identity and explicit override
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_PUBLICATION_PROOF_RUN_ID. Read the actual recovered gate without approving or publishing.

live-gate.intent: The refreshed package retains its accepted review and normal publish gate.

identity-and-override.intent: Review identity ignores presentation changes and rejects altered source evidence.

override-freshness.cmd: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='approval when current package artifact drifted|approval when selected evidence hash drifted' services/gateway/src/methods/run.test.ts
override-freshness.intent: Publication and override both refuse changed evidence before resolving the gate.

direct-run-freshness.cmd: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/command-center/ui/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern='direct run snapshot|publication gate title' apps/command-center/ui/src/components/runs/run-detail-model.test.ts apps/command-center/ui/src/components/runs/run-detail-decision-renderers.test.ts
direct-run-freshness.intent: Gate recovery requires a fresh direct read of the selected run.
